definitions.explanation: Describes something extremely small in scale, especially businesses or operations. Used primarily as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {零細|れいさい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{零細|れいさい}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: Small-scale farmers face tough business conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{零細|れいさい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支援策|しえんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government is considering support measures for very small businesses.

notes:
USAGE:
{零細|れいさい} is composed of ⟦{零|れい}→零：00983_rei⟧ (zero) and {細|さい} (thin, fine), emphasizing extreme smallness. It is almost exclusively used to modify nouns, particularly in business and economic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零細|れいさい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (very small business, micro-enterprise)
- {零細|れいさい}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧ (small-scale farmer)
- {零細|れいさい}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (tiny factory)
- ⟦{中小|ちゅうしょう}→中小：09953_chuushou⟧{零細|れいさい}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (small and micro businesses)
